mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.0% signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates and stimulates economic activity, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%, or Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through strengthened corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST and RSAFS both rising) fails to predict positive returns in more than 50% of instances, or Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 7.0%) triggers central bank policy accommodation that boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic stimulus measures gain traction.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 7.0%, or Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic capacity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 900 thousand units signals strong residential construction and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through increased economic activity and spending.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST exceeds 900.0, or Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0) signals economic contraction and reduced manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as corporate earnings face immediate pressure.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO falls below 95.0, or Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.0% sustains accommodative monetary policy that supports long-term equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through persistent economic stimulus.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%, or Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
